text: Worst experience in McDonald's ever. I usually go everyday with my friends , because i like the ice-cream of McDonald's. The price is very reasonable also. I ordered 3 icecream and one cappuccino. I completed the order and finished the payment by my card but i didn't get the receipt. Then i went to the reception and tell the problem. There was a guy in the reception he told us did i saw the number . I said yes 73. He told me to wait for the number. After 30 minutes I again went to him and tell him why my order isn't coming. Then he told me that they don't have my order on their list. Then i show them my payment. Then they said yes they got it. Then a lady asked me ,What was my order. I told her 3 icecream and one cappuccino. Then they give me my order. The ice-cream was completely melted. I refuse to take this. The lady told me she can't do anything. She refused to give another ice-cream. Then I left the store without taking my food. It was their fault. But they was very rude.  It was very disappointing.
author: Emad Ahmed

text: Location and atmosphere is good. But the service and attitude of the personnel is the worse we have experienced in all fastfood we have ever been to. I was just taking photo of the sitting areas and counter to supposedly write a supportive review but a frowning employee told me it's not allowed to take photo?! There is no such a  sign around. The waiting time is also extremely bad for one simple burger. Our order was already ready and we were standing in front but the personnel was more interested to prepare the next order rather than giving our order. The fries was also undercooked. Sorry to say this but avoid this place because of their service. One unfriendly employee can destroy the good reputation of a well known fastfood chain.
author: GC L

text:
Incredible to wait more than 2 hours for my delivery without any update. To receive in the last 5min that the currier is arriving and see that guy in front of me selecting as completed and take my order to just get inside a building 100mts in the same street where I leave.

Horrible service in APP with non-responsive chats and emails to get a solution.

3 weeks later I have not response from Customer Service with a solution to my order above 50€ that I’m waiting to be reimbursed….

Insist…. HORRIBLE SERVICE incredible how they offer delivery service and you need to deep-search to find a contact and just get a ghosting and failed customer service.

Give me my money back :)
author: Kendall Ramírez

text: Worst McDonald’s I have ever been to. I came for a late night “crispy chicken” sandwich as I was in the area, hungry, and was tired of seafood (the only option most restaurants carry in the area). The place was full of homeless people harassing us! Which made us feel extremely unsafe. The food itself tasted terrible. It took over 20 minutes to get us the sandwich, not sure how is that “fast food”. The fries were cold and saggy. The sandwich itself tasted like chewing a cardboard! Terrible at all levels! Maybe the only good thing is their air conditioned seating area in the upper level, especially in a hot summer day in Lisbon!
author: Peter Khalil

text:
ABSOLUTELY DISGUSTING ALL AROUND!!!!!
This was an awful experience the “macdonalds” security wouldn’t let me a small Canadian girl up on the stairs to wait for my Uber at 5am and immediately after let three girls together up stairs to eat. So when he did I let myself up on the stairs and when he came back down after seating them he proceeded to grab my phone. He claimed it was his manager who wouldn’t let me stand in the stairs but clearly it was his choice, Thankfully others stuck up for me but this guy should be fired legit. Such poor human skills and said I was disrespectful…. Awful service
author: Karalee Helder

text:
normal macs food you would expect. There was a guy who came up to me asking me to buy him a burger and after I refused he went around other customers doing the same.

There were a group of people taunting my friends and I on the upper floor by what I would assume were gang signs which was not a pleasant experience

The floor had spilled drinks and the staff couldn’t be bothered to clean up the area (it was right at the stairs so I thought that was dangerous)

Throughout my 1 hr there I noticed 2 people rummaging through all the dustbins
author: Qingzhe Tan

text:
Wow thanks for advertising it on google as well as in the city but...... Hey surprise, when you arrive its closed (within the designated opening hours) as they seem to have completely shut down the place and are in the process of moving it some place else without any notification.......

Would be nice to get a refund for my uber ride (receipt will be happily sent upon request) for this unnecessry ride!

Thanks for this very disappointing experience and open for your constructive feedback
author: Croissant Fromarsch

text:
Ordered from here. It is amazing how stupid you have to be to mess up an entire order. You literally get a list of items that you simple put in a bag and hand it to the courier. Half of the order was missing. Can’t wait for robots to take over their jobs. At least they are able to follow a simple order.
Ah and on top of it all, it took them almost 1,5hr for that failure. Outstanding. So if you wanna see people and learn how not to work, please go here.
author: Thomas Schulz

text: I have ordered 2 Muffins and 2 cappuccinos and was waiting for 15 minutes. Orders after my number were already served. I told I was hurrying and asked for my order and what the problem is. I was told: it's cappuccino. I mean, cappuccino what? Is it a problem to serve cappuccino in McDonald's? It's just to click a button on the machine. At this time, from 5 persons present at the kitchen, only 2 were doing something, others were just chatting.
author: Nazar Kuzo

text: This is the dirtiest McDonald's I've ever seen. Went to sit on the upper floor with a friend and it was difficult to find a table not covered with food or trails from previous customers. Food was on the floor around most tables and chairs. Took a happy meal, got unfinished fries and a hamburger with a sad thin slice of meat with unhealthy color. Didn't touch it. I feel sorry I didn't take a photo of the food and the "ambiance".
author: M. P.

text: Typical McDonald's in terms of food and service, but the overall experience was uncomfortable. During my visit, there were individuals loitering near the entrance and inside, asking customers to buy them food. It felt intrusive, and staff didn't seem to intervene or manage the situation. It would really help if the management took more active steps to ensure a safer and more comfortable environment for all customers.
author: Hangry Traveller

text: Probably one of the worst McDonald's in Europe that I've ever been to. Breakfast items only include the McMuffin and pancakes. I also ordered a tea but it didn't come with any milk or cream. There was also no milk on the menu to purchase. Ketchup costs 5 cents each which is ridiculous. At 8:00 in the morning they also offered lunch menu items which included the Big Mac and other chicken sandwiches.
author: Lily C

text: It was a typical McDonald's branch. We placed our order, and I must say it was prepared quickly. The food met McDonald's standards. The upper floor was a bit stuffy, but overall, we weren't uncomfortable. Everything was normal until then. I wish I hadn't gone to the restroom. I entered and left as soon as I went in. It smelled really bad and was very dirty. That's unacceptable.
author: Murat Yıkılmaz

text: I was looking forward to eating a hot apple pie. I was so disappointed. The pie was completely cold. It wasn’t even just warm. It was COLD! I never experienced that before. Also the manager was yelling at one of the workers and telling her she needs to stand in place. Such disrespectful behavior. I will now have to toast my pie at home because it’s not edible.
author: C C

text: This restaurant is unsuitable for us as tourists. The lack of hygiene in the restrooms is appalling; I noticed they were incredibly filthy. Furthermore, there's no peace or security; every so often, a homeless person or beggar enters, asking for money and harassing you. This isn't a restaurant; it's filth. Shame on the owners of this disgusting establishment.
author: Emry illkayovič

text: Terrible service, no client respect and support. Took an order to go 2 days ago. After coming home, it turned out they didn’t put nuggets. I contacted McDonald’s Portugal on Instagram, they took my email and said that the restaurant will contact me. I never got any response, no refund, no coupon and we’re leaving the city soon.
author: Kateryna Kutsenko

text:
Hi i paid 2 times for ice cream. When i paid for ice cream they said you didn't pay even i showed my bank account then i had to pay next time again so i paid 2 times and i got 1 ice cream. I didn't get money back. I know it was system mistake but i should get money back.
I hope next time they will be more careful.

text: ATTENTION: FOOD POSINIONING! I ate meat burger and chicken box together yesterday night. After eating I felt very disturbing, in the morning, I felt every symptom of food poisoning. Totally a shame, if you love your health dont every try to check. It’s first time I see to get posioning from such known brand!

text: I had to wait for my coffee and Big Mac more than 20 minutes. My order already disappeared from the screen and it was still not ready. I understand that you have a target for a time of preparing orders but you are cheating. My order was "take away" but it's not. A lot of people, lazy staff, never again 😕

text: The staff forget to do their jobs as soon as there's a little too many people. Waited 20 minutes for 1 drink and a side and the drink was smaller than ordered. Disgraceful order and coordination in the kitchen from my 20 minutes of viewing. This branch should be closed for it's own good. Shameful!!!!!

text: I called to ask if they had decaf coffee. I asked the man but I wasn’t sure if he understood me so I reaped my self and before I finished my sentence he cut me off and said “YES WE HAVE” while screeming at me. And then said “COME STORE NOW MAKE ORDER, ORDER NO ON  PHONE”. Absolutely ridiculous.

text: The burgers were tasteless, and the bacon french fries had no bacon flavor. The Big Tasty Turbo Bacon Double was neither tasty nor turbo in bacon flavor. Honestly, after this meal, I almost wish vomitariums were a thing so I could undo the calorie intake without feeling guilty! 0 out of 10.

text:
They can't make coffee a coffee in 20min.

text: This McDonald's shift Manager (Tania) and some staffs are mannerless. If someone want to see most terrible McDonald's staffs, you are invited in Rossio McDonald's.Request to McDonald's Higher authorities, please teach politeness to Shift managers and employees.

A Portuguese guy asked her and she answered her...

text: Painfully slow. Everyone was moving at the slowest pace I've ever seen, and we watched our food sit on the warming counter for 15 minutes just waiting for our drinks. It was stale and cold. I know it's not supposed to be gourmet, but at least pretend to care.

text: They really need a change of staff. The staff’s deliberately ignored my request for a mayo garlic sauce and I love that stuff and decide to ignore that stuff. And the ice cream… more like warm milk. This became soo melted that I drank it like a soup

text:
Poor service, poor food preparation and taste.

We paid for ketchup and sauces (yes you have to pay ketchup per packet 0,50 euros) and we paid for 4. Got 0 ketchup and told the guy and he gave me attitude and snatched my receipt to check.

text: I placed my order through Electronic device, didn’t get the receipt, order got delayed by 15 minutes. I asked for large fries but it was half filled. No ketchup given no straws. Dine In area on first floor stinks like dumpster.

text: Very bad especially. They took 15 minutes to assemble a McCripsy, calling my number after 5 minutes and not knowing where the order was. The staff was also rude and inexperienced. The cleaning of the location is also not great

did NOT open at 8am as advertised despite a decently sized crowd waiting outside.

food options (especially breakfast) very limited… no sausage mcmuffins, with the only real breakfast options a bacon-egg mcmuffin and pancakes.
